pal.title: Title printed at the top of the theme colour sheet image (palette.png). Short.
pal.board: Row name on the colour sheet for the board-wide colours. 1 word.
pal.how: One line on the colour sheet: a checkered square is not set and uses the board's colour; on the board row it means the app default. Keep short, it shares one line with the legend.
pal.s.c1: Label over a colour sheet square: widget background. Korean: 2 letters.
pal.s.c2: Label over a colour sheet square: accent (buttons, highlights). Korean: 2 letters.
pal.s.c3: Label over a colour sheet square: text colour. Korean: 2 letters.
pal.n.on_accent: Legend entry for a numbered square: text and icons drawn on accent-coloured buttons.
pal.n.line: Legend entry for a numbered square: the outline around each widget.
pal.n.frame: Legend entry for a numbered square: the frame decoration chosen in the widget Look menu.
pal.n.memo_text: Legend entry for a numbered square: text colour on memo paper.
pal.s.hol: Label over a colour sheet square: Sundays and holidays in the calendar. Korean: 2 letters.
pal.s.sat: Label over a colour sheet square: Saturdays in the calendar. Short.
pal.s.danger: Label over a colour sheet square: warning colour (delete confirmations). Korean: 2 letters.
pal.s.stamp: Label over a colour sheet square: the checklist's all-done stamp. Korean: 2 letters.
